name: RiemannBench
intro: Riemann-Bench 是 Surge AI 构建的私有研究级数学基准，包含 25 道由数学研究者编写、经两位领域专家双盲从头求解验证的问题。模型可使用代码与搜索工具，每题运行 100 次独立尝试，并以程序验证器和无偏估计器报告 pass@1。
build_method: 研究数学家原创问题；双盲独立专家从头求解；程序化答案验证；完全私有
eval_feature: 不受约束的研究智能体；每题 100 次独立运行；无偏 pass@1 估计
build_method_en: Original research problems, double-blind from-scratch expert verification, programmatic answer checking, and full privacy
eval_feature_en: Unconstrained research agents, 100 independent runs per problem, and unbiased pass@1 estimation
intro_en: Riemann-Bench is Surge AI's private research-level mathematics benchmark with 25 problems authored by active mathematicians and double-blind verified from scratch by two domain experts. Models may use coding and search tools, run 100 independent attempts per problem, and are scored by problem-specific verifiers with an unbiased pass@1 estimator.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with Riemann-Bench arXiv:2604.06802 Sections 3 and 5, cross-checked against the official Surge AI benchmark page. Riemann-Bench contains 25 fully private, research-level mathematics problems written by Ivy League professors, graduate students, and PhD-holding IMO medalists from problems encountered in their own research. Every item must have an unambiguous unique closed-form answer, support programmatic verification when equivalent forms exist, and pass double-blind verification by two independent domain experts who solve it from scratch without seeing the author solution. Models run as unconstrained research agents with coding tools, search, and open-ended reasoning. Each problem receives 100 independent attempts; programmatic verifiers judge correctness and an unbiased estimator reports pass@1.
